flow: pointer movement changes the selected Speaker or SpeakerSet transform
horizontal drag changes XZ while vertical drag changes Y
orientation controls may change speaker or set orientation
transform changes update the bound AcousticMate model
SpeakerSet member world transforms are resolved from parent and member-local transforms
visible field samples are recomputed on the next animation frame
invariants: speaker and set counts are unrestricted by architecture
each standalone speaker can be moved independently
a SpeakerSet can be manipulated as one parent object in the main visualizer
moving a SpeakerSet preserves its member-local positions and orientations
individual member geometry is edited in SpeakerSetEditor
speaker height participates in modal coupling
speaker/set orientation participates in directional coupling when directivity data exists
drag end is not a calculation trigger or synchronization barrier
multiple rapid transform events collapse into at most one field rebuild per animation frame
reduced preview resolution is allowed only when full resolution is restored after manipulation
